name: PTU Combat Ability Actions
source_guard: active Ability effect text must match the audited conservative signature before automation is exposed

dodge.trigger: user is hit by a Damaging Move

parry.trigger: user is hit by a Melee Attack

effect_spore.trigger: user is hit by a Melee Attack

stalwart.effect: controlled user Attack, Special Attack, Defense and Special Defense +1 CS

prime_fury.effect: controlled user becomes Enraged; Attack and Special Attack +1 CS

hydration.effect: cure one manually tracked Status Affliction
hydration.weather: Rainy Weather ignores frequency but not Swift Action

ice_body.effect: heal one Tick (1/10 max HP); usable below 50% HP or in Hailing Weather; immune to HP loss from Hail
ice_body.source: February 2016 Playtest Packet p.6; PTU Core p.237 (Tick)

deferred_conflicting_or_composite.regal_challenge: Core definition is active but requires a physical AC4 attack against an abstract target
deferred_conflicting_or_composite.sprint: integrated by the composite Sprint Maneuver layer: Standard Action Maneuver + Scene – Swift Action Ability; it is not exposed as a standalone Ability action

non_goals: No enemy/NPC entity or persistent target status.
Resource Undo does not rewind Ability effects.

quick_curl_defense_curl.move_override: Defense Curl as Standard Action Interrupt
